# How Auckland’s ‘main man’ holds the key to disrupting Roar engine room

Reigning champions Auckland FC head into Friday night’s clash at Brisbane Roar off the back of a chastening 5-2 loss to the Wanderers in Matchweek 2.

Pedro Moreira’s side took the lead at CommBank Stadium before conceding four second-half goals, handing them their first loss of the season and Moreira his first stumbling block since taking charge.

The result, and indeed performance, was a marked difference from Auckland’s impressive 3-1 win over Melbourne City in Matchweek 1.

Conversely, Brisbane Roar head into Friday night’s clash having impressed during their 2-1 win over Perth Glory, with South Korean veteran Nam Tae-hee starring for the Roar on his debut.

So what will the key matchups be heading into the Matchweek 3 showdown in Brisbane and who needs to step up?

A-Leagues Champion and former Golden Boot winner Daniel McBreen examined the tactical battle on episode 2 of Total A-Leagues.

“I think we’re all pleasantly surprised by Brisbane and their new signing, Nam,” McBreen said.

“He was quality from the first couple of minutes. I was on the couch in the studio, and we all looked at each other and went, “Yeah, okay, he’s going to be a good player this year” and he topped it off by continuing to play that way for the rest of the game, or 60 minutes of the game and scoring an absolute worldie.

“Now it’s going to be interesting to see how they go.

“It’s one thing to do that against Perth, no disrespect to Perth, but you know when we’re looking at the grand scheme of the A-League clubs, Auckland are champions coming off the back of a defeat that they’re going to be licking their wounds as well.

“We’ve got to look at Lachie Bayliss and say, game one, he was the man, scored a couple of goals, [but] didn’t really produce last week.

“How is that matchup going to go? Who is going to take that game by the scruff of the neck?

“From the looks of it, the midfield in Brisbane this year could be their engine room that actually controls it.

“Last year we saw them go a lot longer and [be] a lot more combative. Now they’ve got that player in midfield, how is that going to happen against Auckland?

“Will they be able to do the same, or will Auckland find their way because they lost their way last week?”

# 奥克兰FC客战布里斯班狮吼，莫雷拉盼防线回稳

北京时间10月30日17:00，澳超第三轮，布里斯班狮吼将在桑科普体育场迎战奥克兰FC（新西兰时间10月30日22:00开球）。布里斯班狮吼因比赛改期错过首轮，上周末迎来赛季首战，凭借贾斯廷-维迪奇和南泰熙上半场的进球2-1击败珀斯光荣，这是他们近十个赛季第二次赢下揭幕战。

奥克兰FC上周末2-5不敌西悉尼流浪者，此前首战他们曾战胜墨尔本城，维塞利奇接德弗里斯传中凌空破门，以18岁之龄成为奥克兰最年轻进球者。对西悉尼一役，奥克兰在半场前两分钟被扳平，下半场开场不久又连丢两球，个人失误让比赛失去悬念。

奥克兰主帅佩德罗-莫雷拉最担心的是防守，上轮丢五球后，他希望后防线拿出更有纪律性的表现。原文指出，如果奥克兰能收紧防守并把握进攻机会，完全有理由带着三分离开布里斯班。

交锋纪录方面，奥克兰FC在澳超正式比赛中对布里斯班狮吼保持不败，四次交手赢下三场，另一场打平；此前两次做客布里斯班均以2-0取胜。布里斯班则希望借助主场优势改写这一纪录。

南泰熙在对珀斯光荣的比赛中用一记凌空抽射打开进球账户，原文提醒奥克兰需要限制他的持球时间。文章强调，周五晚上的焦点不在个别球员，而在奥克兰全队如何从上轮失利中反弹。

原文写道：“冠军球队的评判标准是他们在事情出错时如何反应，奥克兰需要证明上周末只是一次意外，而非未来的征兆。”

# 奥克兰FC客战狮吼，旧将称莫雷拉无需惊慌

澳超第3轮，奥克兰FC将客场前往Suncorp体育场对阵布里斯班狮吼，比赛将于北京时间10月30日17:00开球。狮吼在新赛季首场比赛中主场2-1击败珀斯光荣，取得开门红。

奥克兰FC上一轮客场对阵西部悉尼流浪者遭遇五球惨败。维塞利奇上半场为奥克兰FC首开纪录，博雷洛在半场结束前扳平，下半场流浪者连续进球，前奥克兰边锋吉利翁攻破老东家球门，米拉诺维奇再入一球，奥克兰FC凭借博雷洛的乌龙球一度追近，但德皮齐奥和瓦拉加晚段进球锁定胜局。

前澳超前锋巴尔巴鲁塞斯在A-Leagues: On the Whistle节目中表示：“我不认为奥克兰踢得差。我认为他们在攻防转换中表现糟糕。”他认为流浪者五个进球中有四个是在夺回球权后经过一两次传递打进的，奥克兰FC无法应对，但“我不认为奥克兰有太多值得担心的理由”。

奥克兰FC在第1轮曾以3-1击败墨尔本城，第2轮的惨败与此形成反差。第3轮客场对阵布里斯班狮吼，将是莫雷拉球队的又一次考验。

# Extended Preview: Bring on the defending champs!

Freelance football journalist, Mike Tuckerman returns to preview our clash with defending champions, Auckland FC this Friday night at Suncorp Stadium.

If you’re only as good as your last game, then Brisbane Roar fans are pretty much looking at the best team in the A-League Men’s competition.

The men in orange may have ridden their luck in the second half of last Friday’s 2-1 win over Perth Glory, but there were enough signs in the first half to suggest this new-look team will be tough to beat.

In fact, there were so many positives it’s hard to know where to start. But let’s do so with Justin Vidic, who was deservedly named player of the match on the back of one of his most effective performances in orange.

Brisbane Roar FCBRI

VS

Auckland FCAKL

It wasn’t just that Vidic opened the scoring, peeling away from his marker to tap home Tate Russell’s intelligent cut-back just before the half-hour mark.

Just as impressive was his relentless pressing on the night, which forced Glory to sit deep and spend much of the first half of the back foot.

On another night, Vidic would have scored more than his solitary goal. But he was helped in no small part by Virgiliu Postolachi, whose near-post run dragged former Lions FC defender Cher Deng with him and opened the space for Vidic to tap home the opener.

It was a vindication of coach Michael Valkanis’ decision to play two up top and a signal of attacking intent for the season ahead.

Postolachi had plenty of good moments in a 65-minute A-League Men’s debut, before German import Marko Ilic came on and turned on the afterburners as he tormented the Glory defence.

Ilic’s eye-catching runs down the left-hand side suggest the former TSV Havelse flyer will offer plenty in attack this season and should ensure the side maintains plenty of momentum in the second half of games.

And if we’re singling out impressive attacking performers, how good was Nam Tae-hee?

The former South Korean international was always going to show plenty of class, but few could have predicted just how well he’d control the tempo of the game in midfield.

Nam looked a cut above in that first half against Perth, and he capped an assured display with an early contender for goal of the season when he deftly flicked up a Glory clearance before expertly dispatching it with an expertly taken volley from outside the box.

If Nam stays fit, he’ll be one of the signings of the season.

But there were plenty of others who looked the goods on the night – including, it’s worth pointing out, Joel King.

Yes, the former Sydney FC defender would no doubt love to have his attempted back pass to debutant goalkeeper George Plusnin over again.

But aside from that one mistake, both King and his right-sided counterpart Russell provided plenty of drive going forward and looked calm in defence.

Plusnin himself was rarely tested in assured performance from the 18-year-old, and while Stefan Colakovski could have equalised midway through the second half, the fact that he sliced his one-on-one effort horribly wide suggests that even luck may be on Brisbane Roar’s side this season.

One win doesn’t make a season, of course, but we saw enough in the season opener to suggest the Roar will cause plenty of headaches for opposition sides.

Yet the visit of defending champions Auckland is another step up in quality, even if their English import Sam Cosgrove will miss Friday night’s showdown through suspension.

The Kiwis still have plenty of talent – including former Newcastle Jets flyer Lachie Bayliss and All Whites international Logan Rogerson – and they’ll be out for redemption following their 5-2 mauling at the hands of Western Sydney Wanderers in Parramatta last week.

It all sets up another fascinating clash under the lights at Suncorp Stadium.

Auckland won’t be easy. But on the basis of what we saw last Friday night, there’s no reason to doubt Brisbane Roar won’t take the game to the defending champions.

About Mike Tuckerman: Mike is a freelance football journalist and long-time Brisbane Roar watcher. He has written for the ABC, The Guardian, Australian Football Weekly, Football Australia and theroar.com.au.

科特布斯本赛季首轮就3:1击败赛前被看好的汉诺威96，此后与沃尔夫斯堡战成4:4，并在落后情况下连追三球；对阵圣保利1:1，距离胜利比这支德甲降级队更近；面对此前保持不败的纽伦堡也1:1战平，将对手逼到失利边缘。客场对志在升级的海登海姆，科特布斯拿到1分，门将洛特卡再次贡献神勇表现。

雷恩目前排名联赛第2，前8轮取得5胜1平2负，打进18球，进攻火力明显强于尼斯。最近3轮联赛更是打进10球，前场状态相当不错。不过，雷恩的防守也有问题，8轮丢掉14球，说明这支球队虽然能进球，但也容易给对手机会。

再看交锋和阵容。

双方最近4次交手各赢2场，整体比较接近。不过，今年3月雷恩曾在客场4:0击败尼斯，心理层面多少有些优势。

阵容方面，尼斯后防线存在一定伤停隐患，边路防守尤其需要注意。面对雷恩这种进攻节奏快、前场冲击力强的球队，一旦防守站位出现问题，很容易被抓住机会。

这场比赛的关键在于雷恩的进攻效率。尼斯主场有一定得分能力，但从整体进攻质量和近期状态来看，我认为雷恩还是更值得高看一线。

对于球队近况，潘塔洛尼表示必须享受已经取得的成绩，对球队的表现和结果感到满意，但他认为球队要系统地自我反思，回到健康的基础上，不要把自己看得比实际更强。他强调球队必须继续在欠缺的方面努力、加倍付出，因为接下来又将面对一个非常难对付的对手。

# TV2评论员质疑博德闪耀锋线配置，维京领跑金牌战

北京时间10月31日02:00，挪超将迎来一场可能决定本赛季冠军归属的关键战，博德闪耀坐镇阿斯普米拉主场迎战维京。两队目前相差三分，维京处于领跑位置。

TV2评论员罗宾-格罗夫在赛前表示，一分对维京来说将非常棒，如果维京拿到三分，联赛就结束了。

格罗夫对博德闪耀夏窗的转会操作提出质疑。卡斯帕-霍今夏被出售后，博德闪耀没有引进新的前锋，而是全力押注赫尔默森保持健康。格罗夫说：“让我非常惊讶的是，他们在今夏卡斯帕-霍被出售时没有引进一名前锋。”他认为博德闪耀多年来在球员引进方面表现出色，但今夏的操作是一次失误，最终可能受到惩罚。

格罗夫同时指出，维京选择用前博德闪耀前锋博海姆加强进攻，这最终可能成为完全决定性的因素。

# Preview: Elversberg vs Mainz 05 - prediction, team news, lineups

Newly-promoted Elversberg will hope to get their Bundesliga season back on track by beating visitors Mainz 05 on Friday at Waldstadion an der Kaiserlinde.

The hosts may have lost against RB Leipzig on October 24, but they are still in eighth place with 10 points after seven matchweeks, tied on points with seventh-placed Mainz.

## Match preview

Elversberg's 4-0 loss against Leipzig was the result of a second-half collapse, with their opponents scoring all of their goals after the interval.

Their loss does not detract from the fact the hosts have enjoyed a strong opening to their first ever Bundesliga season, and a four-point gap to the bottom three at this stage is a strong start.

However, boss Vincent Wagner will understandably be concerned that his side have lost four of their last six games in all competitions, drawing once and winning once in that time.

Schwarz und Weiss have also failed to find the back of the net in four of their past five matches, while they averaged two goals conceded in each of those games.

Elversberg may have lost 2-0 against Darmstadt in the DFB-Pokal's second round at Waldstadion an der Kaiserlinde on Tuesday, but they have triumphed in two of their three top-flight clashes at the stadium.

Mainz also suffered a DFB-Pokal defeat, losing 2-0 against VfL Bochum on Tuesday, and that was their third loss in four fixtures.

Their latest Bundesliga result saw Werder Bremen emerge as 3-2 winners against them on Saturday, though the victors benefitted from two penalties.

Friday will be just the third ever meeting between the two clubs, with both encounters taking place in the DFB-Pokal, and Mainz will hope to maintain their 100% record against their hosts.

Though the visitors were beaten by Bochum away from home, head coach Urs Fischer had overseen victories in each of his side's first four outings on the road in 2026-27.

In their three away Bundesliga wins, Mainz scored 10 goals, kept two clean sheets and conceded on just three occasions.

谈到怀尔德，菲利普斯强调了后者的执教经验：“他经验丰富；就升级而言，他是那个联赛中最有经验的主教练之一，而且他对这家俱乐部了如指掌。”

本场比赛将有多名旧将重返布拉莫巷。奥哈雷在转会截止日以约700万英镑的转会费离开谢菲尔德联加盟雷克瑟姆，目前尚未为新东家打入首球。基弗-穆尔则在2025年夏天完成转会，他曾随谢菲尔德联出战2025年在温布利对阵桑德兰的附加赛决赛，代表球队出场30次打入6球。

Sheffield United and Wrexham have shared 27 goals in their last five meetings, and both sides scored in every one. Friday's Championship game at Bramall Lane (8pm, Sky Sports) puts that record on the line, with only two points between 12th and 17th.

Using Sofascore's Championship season data and Flashscore's Sheffield United vs Wrexham team news, these are the numbers that frame the game.
...
### Sheffield United vs Wrexham: The key numbers

Wrexham won both league meetings last season, 5-3 at the Racecourse on Boxing Day and 2-1 at Bramall Lane in March. Four of the last five meetings have produced four goals or more.

Chris Wilder's side sit 12th on 16 points (W4 D4 L4). Phil Parkinson's Wrexham are 17th on 14 (W3 D5 L4), six points clear of the bottom three.

The number that should worry Wilder most is his side's home record. They've won two of six at Bramall Lane and sit 17th in the Championship home table, below their 13th place in the away table. For a club with a 32,000-capacity ground, that isn't good enough.
...
Wrexham's away record is worse: one win in six, five goals scored and 10 conceded, 18th in the away table.

### How Sheffield United and Wrexham match up

##### Sheffield United are happy without the ball

The Blades average just 43% possession, yet they've created 20 big chances and had 46 shots on target, more than Wrexham on both counts. They're at their best when they let the opposition have the ball and break quickly, and Wrexham, who average 50%, are likely to have plenty of it.
...
##### Wrexham's set-piece threat is real

Wrexham have won 66 corners to Sheffield United's 43, and they've scored four headed goals to the Blades' two. With a 6ft 5in centre-forward in Kieffer Moore, every dead ball near the box is a chance, and Sheffield United will need to defend them well.

##### Cleworth's absence is the biggest number of all

Max Cleworth is Wrexham's highest-rated player this season (7.33) and he's out with a muscle injury. Nathan Broadhead, Liberato Cacace, Josh Windass and Sebastian Revan are also missing, and George Thomason is a doubt. Losing your best defender before a trip to a side that creates big chances is a serious blow.

player analytics

Moore is the outlier. He has scored five goals from 2.21 xG, more than twice what his chances suggest, which tells you how clinical he's been. Bamford's five from 4.56 xG is steadier and more repeatable.

Sydie Peck is the Blades' creator, with 18 key passes and four big chances made. If he gets time on the ball, Sheffield United's forwards will get chances. For Wrexham, Danny Imray (three assists) and Ben Whiteman (two assists, 7.15 average rating) supply most of the service to Moore.
...
### The Verdict

On this season's numbers, Sheffield United are the stronger side, with a better goal difference (+1 against -3), more shots on target and twice as many clean sheets. Wrexham have the better recent history and the best finisher on the pitch.

My view: This is the Blades' chance to fix their home form against a depleted Wrexham defence, but they can't afford to switch off at set pieces.

Preview: Sporting Lisbon vs. Casa Pia - prediction, team news, lineups

Sporting Lisbon's unbeaten run in the Primeira Liga will be put to the test when they face an in-form Casa Pia side at Estadio Jose Alvalade on Saturday.

Ruben Amorim's team have reeled off seven consecutive victories ahead of this weekend's gameweek eight match-up against a side that have accrued eight points from their last 12.

## Match preview

Sporting's eight-match winning streak in all competitions ended with a 1-1 Champions League draw with PSV on Tuesday, and they seek a return to winning ways on their return to league competition.

Amorim's troops have defeated every opponent played in the Liga going into Saturday when they are favourites to notch an eighth straight top-flight success.

The defending league champions are expected to make light work of visiting Casa Pia, given an impressive winning run that has seen them outscore every Liga club whilst keeping clean sheets at the other end.

Leoes head into this weekend on the back of five shutouts in a row and will back themselves to record a sixth on the trot at Casapianos' expense.

Further strengthening the home side's optimism is their record in previous matches since the away side gained promotion, with four wins secured on the trot and a fifth anticipated this weekend.

Although it was nearly nine months back, the away side must dread another visit to a side that hit them for eight in January to record a heavy defeat on Os Gansos.

Casa Pia headed into that fixture after consecutive road victories but could not resist Amorim's men, who had three players score twice in that harrowing 8-0 defeat.

Even though Joao Pereira was not in situ at the turn of the year, the head coach takes his players to the Jose Alvalade keen to avoid a similar outcome against the division's leading scorers.

The confidence is high following four points from the last available six in away games and eight points in the preceding four games, but facing Sporting is a different kettle of fish for any side in the division.

While they head into Saturday aiming to extend their undefeated four-match sequence, Casa Pia will do well to avoid another heavy loss to the title favourites.

# 环球体育：米拉索尔客战科林蒂安盼破客场不胜魔咒

米拉索尔本周五将在Neo Química竞技场对阵科林蒂安，目标是远离巴西甲级联赛降级区，并打破一项历史魔咒：米拉索尔从未在客场击败过科林蒂安。

双方共交手9次，科林蒂安7胜2平，黑白军团打进16球，米拉索尔只进了3球。

米拉索尔这支来自圣保罗州内陆的球队拿到的唯一积分，正是在双方最初两次交手时获得的，两场比赛都在帕卡恩布球场进行：2008年0-0战平，2010年圣保罗州锦标赛又以1-1收场。

此后，科林蒂安在主场又赢下双方随后的7次交锋。科林蒂安在Neo Química竞技场保持全胜，6场6胜，米拉索尔只在2022年的那场2-1中打进1球。

双方最近一次交手是在2025年10月的巴甲第27轮，科林蒂安3-0获胜。

尽管在圣保罗州的交锋记录不利，米拉索尔此役在积分榜上的位置更好。米拉索尔排在第15位，积37分，比身处降级区的科林蒂安多4分，后者目前有33分。

科林蒂安本赛季主场表现也可能给身披黄绿战袍的米拉索尔带来机会。巴甲本赛季16个主场里，科林蒂安只拿到5胜，积19分，而他们在客场还拿到14分。

不过，米拉索尔客场同样困难重重。米拉索尔的客场战绩仅排第15位，15场只赢2场，45分中拿到10分，胜率22.2%。

因此，这场直接对话将两支被积分榜下游压力包围的球队摆到了一起。科林蒂安希望逃离降级区，米拉索尔则想继续拉开与降级区的差距，并首次在客场击败这个对手。
